evidence_occurrences.evidence_text:
### stage 1: Arranging horizontal photos

I made a lot of ideal subsequences from horizontal photos and with different tricks tried to reduce number of subsequences. The most powerful trick is using vertical photos to stitch two horizontal subsequences. As a result I got an ideal slideshow with 32116 slides (30000 horizontal + 4232 vertical).

### stage 2: Matching the remaining vertical photos

I used slightly modified method proposed by [@huikang](https://www.kaggle.com/huikang)[here](https://www.kaggle.com/huikang/441k-in-11-mins). I vectorize this code and set penalty for slide size (12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19). This stuff got me additional 60 points.

### stage 3: Arranging all photos

I added the combined photos from stage 2 to the slideshow from stage 1, then again do exactly what I did in stage 1. As a result I got score 443293.

### stage 4: Post processing

Simple processing: reversing part of the slideshow trying to increase the score.
